fields.why: Incidence tables and GBD figures are cited, but the report aggregates unpublished eJRF case counts (59–62 countries; 8,800 to 1 million) and computes 3/44 (7%) itself, so yes is slightly better supported; limited is defensible.

A 'Progress Toward' report tracking TCV introduction (3 of 44 high-incidence countries) reads as monitoring progress, but there is no formal target, so surveillance/descriptive alone is also defensible.

SES appears only as a country-level income/Gavi-eligibility descriptor and a financial-barrier remark; the brief does not say whether country income group is an SPD or geography. Rule needed: country income classification as descriptor = SES level 1 (or explicitly geography = level 0).

brief_issues: Brief should state whether country income classification (World Bank/LMIC, Gavi eligibility) counts as an SES dimension, and whether 'Progress Toward' reports without a numeric target count as evaluation or monitoring.
